name: org-workbench
description: Org Workbench — file tree is the org chart. Electron shell + local control plane for digital-employee workspaces.

scripts.package:macos:unsigned: npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:electron:macos && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64 --publish never && npm run verify:package:macos
scripts.package:win:unsigned: npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:electron:win && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --publish never && npm run verify:package:win
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:scripts && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run test:ui && node --test "apps/server/dist/test/*.test.js" && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:desktop-main && npm run security:check
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:renderer && electron apps/desktop/src/main.js
